name: At the Envoy’s End (Combat, Panache)
body:
Bardic inspiration guides your sword’s point.

Prerequisite(s): Amateur Swashbuckler feat or panache class feature, bardic performance class feature.

Benefit(s): As a swift action, you can end an Act, Comedy, Dance, Oratory, or Sing performance to gain a morale bonus on an attack that uses the bleeding wound, deadly stab, perfect thrust, precise strike, stunning stab, or targeted strike deeds. The bonus gained is equal to the number of bardic performance rounds you spent.
